summary: Ephemeral crypto-wrapped, PII-scrubbed inference trace export for partner investigation
justification: Partner support team requested a short-lived replay of a small set of inference requests to validate a billing discrepancy reported by a strategic channel partner. Partner provided timestamps and one masked session id; revops requests cryptographically wrapped, redacted artifact for 48-hour analysis window under dual-approval.
description:
Issue summary: Revenue Operations requested an export of ~420 inference requests from prod for a single partner account window (2026-03-05 14:00 to 2026-03-05 15:30 UTC) to reconcile tokenization/billing differences. Data must be minimized, PII removed, and delivered in an encrypted, access-controlled bundle with two-person control for decryption.

Impact: Customer-facing billing discrepancy; small set of partner customers may see invoice mismatch. Operational risk: exposure of customer prompts/outputs if redaction is incomplete. Need immediate but controlled access to avoid delaying partner reconciliation.

Requested artifact: - Hash-only mapping for user identifiers (SHA256 with per-export salt) - Timestamped inference traces limited to request/response metadata and token counts - No raw prompt text or raw outputs; where necessary for triage provide redacted excerpts with words replaced by <REDACTED> and a deterministic pseudonymization mapping. - Bundle must be KMS-wrapped (customer-facing key controlled by Redwood KMS) and stored in a time-limited S3 bucket with lifecycle to auto-delete after 48 hours.

Access controls & constraints: - Dual-control decryption: approval required from Compliance and SRE lead before keys are provisioned. - Audit trail: every retrieval must be logged to the secure audit index and a copy of the retrieval event sent to #security-audit. - Only participants: (Priya Kumar - RevOps), (Marco Silva - SRE), (Alex Chen - Compliance) may access. - No copies permitted on personal devices; temporary mount-only access on hardened bastion.

Steps to produce (SRE runbook excerpt): 1) Run the constrained query against the production trace index with projection to only include: session_id_hash, request_id, model_version, token_count_request, token_count_response, latency_ms, status_code, redacted_output_snippet. 2) Salted-hash session_id using ephemeral salt stored as part of the bundle metadata; salt destroyed after wrap. 3) Apply deterministic redact pipeline to any free-text fields (replace words on configured blacklist with <REDACTED>). 4) Package as newline-delimited JSON, sign with internal artifact signing key, then encrypt with KMS-wrapped data key. 5) Push to s3://redwood-ephemeral-exports/INT-384999/ and set bucket object lifecycle to expire in 48 hours. 6) Notify approvers via Slack thread and require both approvers to acknowledge before providing S3 pre-signed URL.

Retention & disposal: Bundle auto-deletes after 48 hours. Any manual copies must be declared and will be subject to deletion certificate signed by Compliance.

Risk assessment: Moderate — exposure risk mitigated by redaction and dual control, but small chance of residual sensitive token in redacted snippet. Recommend additional manual spot-check of 5 random records by Compliance prior to approval.

Requested timeline: Run the extract within 24 hours of approval and provide access window no longer than 48 hours.

Approval checklist (for approvers): - [ ] RevOps confirmed scope and that partner consent covers minimized export - [ ] Compliance spot-check completed - [ ] SRE verified query projection returns no raw prompts - [ ] Security approves KMS wrapping and access controls
